name: format.seconds
description: Renders a duration in seconds as V1's short human form (`1d 1h`), so time-lock delays and challenge windows read the same as in V1 entries. Exists because V1 applies this through a Blip `format` edit that a plan cannot express. Replaces the `formatSeconds` type caster used by Blip `format`.
input: A `call` result (or a `$step` value) holding a number of seconds: a JSON number, or a decimal string for values above 2^53.
output: A string such as `1y 1mo`, `2mo 3d`, `1m 1s` or `0s`: the largest non-zero unit followed by the next unit down when it is non-zero, smaller units dropped; negative values get a leading `-`; values above 2^53 - 1 render as `more than 285616414y 8mo`, as in V1.
